name: youtube-summarizer
title_zh: 自动抓取油管字幕，摘要与全文一起发到聊天框
tagline_zh: 看视频懒得记笔记？粘贴链接，它自动拉字幕、提炼要点，连全文一起推到你的消息应用里。支持元数据与可下载文本。
tagline_en: Paste a YouTube link, get structured key insights plus the full transcript delivered to your messaging app.
desc_en: Automatically fetch YouTube video transcripts, generate structured summaries, and send full transcripts to messaging platforms. Detects YouTube URLs and provides metadata, key insights, and downloadable transcripts.
why_zh: 不是简单抓字幕，而是把「摘要+全文+元数据」打包成一条消息，省去切换窗口的麻烦。自动识别链接。
why_en: It doesn't just fetch captions—it bundles summary, full text, and metadata into one message, saving you tab-switching.
limit_zh: 仅支持 YouTube 链接，且需视频有公开字幕（自动生成亦可）。摘要依赖转录质量，无字幕视频会失败。
limit_en: YouTube only, requires public captions (auto-generated OK). No captions = fail. Full transcript may exceed messaging platform limits—you handle.
title_en: Fetch YouTube transcript, send summary & full text to chat
